title: PixVerse V5.5 Video Generation Prompt Schema
description: Schema for validating PixVerse V5.5 video generation prompts produced by this skill. Covers text-to-video, image-to-video, and effects pipelines.

prompt.description: Scene description in natural language. No special syntax. Subject MUST come first — PixVerse parses sequentially and gives early elements more weight. Include explicit motion verbs. Max 2,048 characters.

negative_prompt.description: Comma-separated elements to suppress. Strongly recommended. Standard baseline: 'blurry, distorted faces, extra limbs, watermark, low quality, jerky motion, morphing, flickering'. Max 2,048 characters.
negative_prompt.default: blurry, distorted faces, extra limbs, watermark, low quality, jerky motion, morphing, flickering

model.description: PixVerse model version. Use 'v5.5' for standard production. 'v5.6' for latest improvements in motion clarity and lip sync. Camera movement presets (21 options) only available on v4/v4.5.

aspect_ratio.description: Frame aspect ratio. 16:9 for widescreen/cinematic. 9:16 for vertical/mobile. 1:1 for square/social. 3:4 and 4:3 for standard formats.

quality.description: Output resolution. 360p = turbo/fast mode. 720p = balanced (supports all durations). 1080p = highest quality (max 8s duration). CRITICAL: 1080p cannot generate 10-second clips.

duration.description: Clip duration in seconds. 10s max at 720p or below. 8s max at 1080p. 5s for fastest generation and best quality.

style.description: Visual style preset. Omit (null) for photorealistic or non-preset aesthetics. Only use when the preset genuinely matches the project direction.

motion_mode.description: 'normal' = standard motion. 'fast' = increased speed and intensity. CONSTRAINT: 'fast' only works at 5-second duration and below 1080p.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. Lock the seed when a generation is 80% correct, then refine only the prompt. Same seed + same prompt + same settings = same output.

generate_audio_switch.description: Enable native audio generation: BGM (background music), SFX (sound effects), and dialogue with lip sync. Adds 20-30% processing time. V5.6 improves multi-character lip sync.

generate_multi_clip_switch.description: Enable multi-shot cinematic mode. Automatically breaks the scene into 1-3 camera shots (establishing, medium, close-up) with smooth transitions. Pacing adapts to content.

thinking_type.description: Prompt optimization engine. 'enabled' = model rewrites and optimizes (best for simple prompts). 'disabled' = uses prompt exactly as written (best for precise control). 'auto' = model decides.

camera_movement.description: Camera movement preset. 21 options available. CONSTRAINT: Only available on v4/v4.5 models. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with template_id (effects). For v5.5, describe camera movement in the prompt text instead.

template_id.description: Effects template ID (1-46). For the effects pipeline. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with camera_movement. Replaces V5's transition endpoint.

generation_mode.description: 'text-to-video' = from prompt only. 'image-to-video' = animate a source image (prompt describes motion only). 'effects' = apply template effect to source image.

source_image.description: Source image for image-to-video or effects mode.

img_id.description: PixVerse image ID (from upload API). Required for I2V and effects modes.

image_url.description: Local path or URL to the source image. For tracking — not sent directly to API (upload first to get img_id).

frame_references.description: Start and/or end frame references for visual guidance. The AI interpolates motion between the two frames.

start_frame_url.description: URL or path to start frame image.

end_frame_url.description: URL or path to end frame image. AI interpolates motion from start to end.

audio_intent.description: Structured audio intent. Supplements the generate_audio_switch — tracks what kind of audio the director expects. Audio generation is automatic when the switch is on, but this helps validate output.

dialogue.description: Expected spoken dialogue. Should also be described in the main prompt for lip sync.

sfx_expectation.description: Expected sound effects based on the scene content.

metadata.description: Pipeline tracking metadata. Not sent to PixVerse API — used for internal tracking.

skill_version.description: SKILL version that generated this prompt.

continuity_anchor.description: Whether this shot serves as a visual reference for continuity.

source_image_skill.description: If the source image was generated by another SKILL, note which one (e.g., 'ideogram-v3').

allOf._comment: 1080p at 10 seconds is not supported — this combination is invalid.
Fast motion mode is not available at 1080p.
Fast motion mode only works at 5-second duration.

not._comment: camera_movement and template_id are mutually exclusive.
